scope: The publicly reachable registration code-request and registration code-verification body reader, preserving registration business workflows.

originalObservations.method: Existing real module with native Request/ReadableStream in an empty application environment, forbidden workflow dependencies, and denied fetch/http/https/net/tls.
reproduced: A valid pre-aborted native Request was still accepted.
An abort during an incomplete stream remained pending and the eventual complete payload was accepted.
A valid but incomplete body remained pending after8262ms; no body-read deadline existed.
A2049-byte body waited for a stalled cancellation before returning its existing413 error.
originalObservations.limit: The read-only probes reproduce transport behavior, not an actual attack, production failure, availability measurement or account/mail mutation.

preserved.utf8: Strict UTF8 with initial BOM handling; no replacement of malformed bytes.
preserved.originSiteAndTypeGuards: Original order and exact source text retained.
preserved.schema: Exactly email for request, exactly email/code for verify; normalization and six decimal digits unchanged.
preserved.workflows: Original database-client configuration, mail allowlist, reservation and rate limit, bcrypt, atomic code-attempt/consume RPCs, subscription resolution, session issuance, cookies and error response suffix are byte-identical.
preserved.routes: After reverting only the imported guard name and one immediate post-read assertion, each original route is byte-identical.
preserved.fixtures: The complete pre-existing registration test is unchanged after removing only setTimeout and clearTimeout from its VM globals.
preserved.excluded: Push, login-code, payment, account-deletion, SQL, roles, secrets and provider settings are outside this change.

freshChecks: Before reader acquisition and before every read.
Immediately after each awaited read, including EOF.
Before decoding/parsing, after parsing, before returning normalized fields.
Immediately after the route awaits the reader and before mail allowlist/database/workflow calls.
change.errorOwnership: Only the invocation-local WeakSet of constructed reader errors can be propagated. Arbitrary transport errors, including supplied AccountRegistrationError instances, are normalized to the existing503 unavailable response.
change.cleanup: The acquired reader receives one best-effort cancellation without awaiting its promise, a release attempt, timer cleanup, and abort-listener removal. Cleanup rejections cannot replace a result.
change.limits: This guards transport until workflow entry; it does not cancel or undo a registration workflow already begun, add a new rate policy or guarantee general attack prevention.

methods: A genuine8000ms timeout with native incomplete stream and never-settling cancel.
Native pre/acquisition/chunk/EOF/decoding abort cases and post-await route abort.
2048/2049 byte limits, dishonest size header, original guard/schema responses, strict UTF8/BOM boundary cases.
Throwing/rejected/stalled cancel, locked/acquisition-failing reader, arbitrary rejection reasons, timer/listener/reader ownership cleanup.
Existing isolated PostgreSQL/bcrypt registration workflow and login UI tests with all existing assertions retained.
validation.environment: Application secrets/live opt-ins are not inherited by required test children. NoNet preload denies external network; PostgreSQL, SMTP and providers remain isolated fixtures.
